cases.expect: one bounded ok:true line echoes revision, generation, candidate run, selection digest and ordered library digests; all inspection children reaped; old run remains live until replacement

cases.input: invalid ABI descriptor, missing admitted deployment binding, 3 MiB ListSkills overflow, or duplicate identity after IsOS P01 verification
cases.expect: sanitized ok:false with nonzero exit before managers.remove; execute count zero; checked candidate-grant retirement; old PIDs, run ID, active revision, grants and run scope unchanged

cases.input: wrong selected leaf, saved revision, candidate verifier run, or selection file digest
cases.expect: pre-stop rejection with no guest handler or old-child stop

cases.input: preflight invocation with socket, journal, adapter, backend or listener option; inspect process tree and descriptors
cases.expect: extra options rejected; no listener, adapter, journal, simulator, Dispatcher release or primitive execution

cases.input: inspection worker stalls near the global 90-second deadline, crashes, or fails confirmed reap; candidate grant retirement fails after rejected probe
cases.expect: hard global timeout or cleanup-unconfirmed diagnostic; process-group and candidate-grant cleanup checked; old run remains live and failure does not claim clean stop

cases.input: missing, duplicate, oversized, malformed or mismatched JSON line, or exit status inconsistent with ok
cases.expect: IsOS maps malformed output to skill_catalog_preflight_invalid_output, valid rejection to skill_catalog_preflight_rejected, deadline/signal to skill_catalog_preflight_timeout and unconfirmed cleanup to skill_catalog_preflight_cleanup_unconfirmed; no old-child stop

cases.input: selected library or runtime bytes change after ok:true but before candidate spawn
cases.expect: IsOS recheck or fresh EOS launch admission rejects change; probe result is not launch authority; checked grant retirement on pre-stop rejection and existing recovery path after old stop

cases.input: automatic EOS restart within same IsOS run after successful preflight, then selected file changes
cases.expect: new EOS repeats managed and ABI admission, rejects changed bytes before ready, and never reuses previous probe result
